== Course of events ==

Having failed to defeat Dorothy and her companions by force — her swarm of black bees broken against the Tin Woodman's body, her forty crows destroyed by the Scarecrow, and her armed Winkies driven off by the Cowardly Lion's roar — the Witch turns to trickery instead. She tricks Dorothy into losing one of her Silver Shoes. Furious at the theft, Dorothy responds by throwing water on the Witch.

The water proves fatal to the Witch: she melts away and dies on the spot, and with her death her tyranny comes to an end. This sudden collapse of her power clears the way for what follows, as the Witch can no longer threaten Dorothy and her companions directly, and it is only afterward that the Winkies are freed and other matters, such as the fate of the Golden Cap's final charm, play out.
